name: work subject and correction
description: Tests entity correction detection and reference resolution: the user mentions a work problem, then corrects a named entity, and finally refers back to the topic. Verifies that the engine updates its entity memory correctly and maintains topic continuity.

turns.text: I meant my manager, not my boss

expected.finalTurn: The engine should detect 'it happened again' as a reference to the current subject (work), maintain topic continuity, and not use stale entity callbacks for the corrected entity.
expected.behavior: detectEntityCorrection should identify 'my manager' as the corrected surface. The correction updates the engine's entity memory and topic context. The follow-up reference resolves to the work topic via resolveReferenceContext.
